adaptive_retrieval_ablation_isolated.details: Candidate depth schedule pinned to base k under NO_ADAPTIVE_RETRIEVAL; reformulation executed and isolated in telemetry.

known_supported_cases_accepted.details: All 5 synthetic test categories (direct facts, methods, quantitative, multi-hop, paraphrases) validated as SUPPORTED.

genuinely_unsupported_cases_rejected.details: Genuinely ungrounded claim strictly rejected; structured downgrade category EVIDENCE_UNSUPPORTED returned.

retrieval_memory_produces_valid_hit.details: End-to-end evidence delivery verified on cache hits; chunk IDs, text payloads, and coverage preserved; depth and session/document isolation enforced; malformed entry fallback verified.

eligible_cross_lingual_pairs_evaluated.details: Eligible bilingual pairs evaluated; monolingual pairs bypassed as SKIPPED (MONOLINGUAL) rather than falsely counted.

model_timeouts_and_monotonic_timing_enfo.details: Explicit HTTP timeouts enforced with ModelTimeoutError; sleep/suspension drift detected and flagged with LatencyContaminationError.

telemetry_distinguishes_execution_bypass.details: Telemetry cleanly records execution vs bypass vs skip vs failure; downgrade_details captures structured defect categories.
